PROOF_IDS_NOTE: 10,11,12,13: action record is what the worker returns, what the verifier checks/rejects, what the fallback appends, and what gates VERIFIED. 14: ordered digest-bound records are what replay re-projects. Secondary: 3 (span-kind taxonomy + evidence_refs give the graph its edges).
PURPOSE: Agent execution trace mechanism: the per-action record schema (action_type/params/returns/timestamps/agent_id/session_id + LLM prompt/completion/tokens/cost + tool name/params/result/status + error trigger linkage), the span-kind taxonomy (session > agent > tool/llm/operation/task/workflow), and the agent-specific telemetry attribute set. Clean-room re-derivation only; no AgentOps code is copied and the SDK (opentelemetry-sdk, exporter-otlp, requests, psutil, wrapt) is rejected for adoption.
SMALLEST_MISSING_PRIMITIVE: AgentAction record: an append-only, ordered per-mission action entry {seq, action_id, mission_id, attempt_id, span_kind, actor, target, input_digest, output_digest, started_at, ended_at, outcome (ok|error|unknown), error_ref, evidence_refs[], canonical_bytes} written to the PING event spine. AgentOps proves the per-action input/output binding and kind taxonomy valuable; PING adds what AgentOps lacks: digest binding, append-only authority, an explicit outcome state machine, and verifier coupling.
